verdict.rationale: Cursor ships an official CLI (cursor.com/cli) and supports 'always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers,' implying some programmatic/automation surface, but the evidence pack never documents a formal public API (REST/GraphQL/SDK) for driving Cursor externally — MCP docs only cover Cursor acting as an MCP client, not exposing itself as a controllable API. Missing for 10: explicit public API reference docs, authentication/endpoint details, and independent confirmation that external tools can programmatically control Cursor beyond the CLI.
